login_code.subject: Your sign-in code: {{code}}
login_code.body:
Hello,

Your sign-in code for TAK Manager is:

    {{code}}

It is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can be used once. If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: nobody can sign in without the code.

invitation.subject: {{inviter}} invites you to the team {{team}}
invitation.body:
Hello,

{{inviter}} invites you to join the team "{{team}}" on TAK Manager, where you will get your access to the TAK server.

To answer, sign in with this e-mail address ({{email}}):

    {{url}}

The invitation is waiting on your home page. If you do not know this team, ignore this message.

team_request.subject: New team request: {{team}}

team_approved.subject: Your team {{team}} is approved

team_rejected.subject: Your team request {{team}} was not approved

event_invitation.subject: {{host}} invites your team to the event {{event}}

event_accepted.subject: {{team}} joins your event {{event}}
event_accepted.body:
Hello,

The team "{{team}}" accepted your invitation to the event "{{event}}" ({{start}} to {{end}}).

Its members share the channel {{channel}} with yours for the duration of the event.

    {{url}}

event_declined.subject: {{team}} declined your event {{event}}
event_declined.body:
Hello,

The team "{{team}}" declined your invitation to the event "{{event}}" ({{start}} to {{end}}).

You can invite it again from your team's page:

    {{url}}

event_left.subject: {{team}} left your event {{event}}

event_cancelled.subject: The event {{event}} is cancelled
event_cancelled.body:
Hello,

The event "{{event}}" hosted by the team "{{host}}" ({{start}} to {{end}}) has been cancelled.

Its channel {{channel}} no longer exists: the teams that took part no longer see each other on the TAK server.

    {{url}}

event_rescheduled.subject: New dates for the event {{event}}

event_ended_early.subject: The event {{event}} has ended
event_ended_early.body:
Hello,

The team "{{host}}" ended the event "{{event}}" before its planned end.

Its channel {{channel}} no longer exists: the teams that took part no longer see each other on the TAK server.

    {{url}}

event_team_removed.subject: Your team is no longer part of the event {{event}}
event_team_removed.body:
Hello,

The team "{{host}}" took your team "{{team}}" out of the event "{{event}}" ({{start}} to {{end}}).

If your team was taking part, its members stopped seeing the other teams, and being seen by them, at once.

    {{url}}
